name: Vinsobres

limits: For red wine, Grenache: at least 50%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 25%

For red wine, Bourboulenc, Brun Argenté, Carignan, Cinsault, Clairette, Clairette Rose, Counoise, Grenache Blanc, Grenache Gris, Marsanne, Muscardin, Piquepoul Blanc, Piquepoul Noir, Roussanne, Terret Noir, Ugni Blanc and Viognier together: at most 20%
For white wine, Clairette, Grenache Blanc, Marsanne, Roussanne and Viognier together: at least 75%
For red wine, Grenache, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 80%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône appellation for red wine and, since 2026, white wine. It became its own AOC in 2006 as a Rhône cru after belonging to Côtes-du-Rhône Villages. Some vineyards were once olive groves.
